scope: Reviewed right hand without tactile markers; optional frozen snapshot, not the default URDF conversion output.
coordinate_convention: OBJ vertices are in the owner link frame unless shared_template is set. Then template_to_owner maps column homogeneous template coordinates into the owner link frame (translation in metres).

physics.note: This snapshot preserves the reviewed engineering dynamics, including palm rubber inertia; it does not replace the canonical URDF inertia. Parent-body filtering is backend dependent.

usd_runtime_dependency: OmniPBR.mdl is provided by Isaac Sim/Omniverse for rendering; headless Newton does not need this shader.
